storageVersion.description: The version of the storage, absent before storage versions existed (version 1). The app migrates older versions at startup, see packages/dashql-app/src/migration, and refuses newer ones.

connections.description: The connections, the source of truth for the connection settings that sessions replicate. Absent in manifests written before connections were global, an empty array means there are no connections.

ConnectionEntry.description: A connection that sessions reference by its id

id.description: The connection identifier (UUID), sessions reference the connection with it

params.description: The saved connection parameters, every session referencing the connection stores a copy

paramsDraft.description: Unsaved edits of the connection parameters, including incomplete or invalid settings. Never replicated into sessions.

aliases.description: Identifiers of connections that were consolidated into this one. Sessions referencing an alias are resolved to this connection.

path.description: The session identity as a bare session UUID.

storageType.description: Where this session's files live. Defaults to "opfs" when omitted (the OPFS root). "native" means the files live directly in `nativePath`. Mirrors the `storageType` field on the session itself.

nativePath.description: Absolute directory holding this session's files. Required when storageType is "native"; one directory holds exactly one session.

aiProvider.description: Configuration of the OpenAI-compatible AI provider

AIProviderHeader.description: Additional HTTP header sent with AI provider requests

AIProviderSettings.description: Configuration for an OpenAI-compatible AI provider (Ollama, OpenAI, vLLM, etc.)

endpointUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. http://localhost:11434)

model.description: The model identifier to use for chat completions

auth.description: How requests to the AI provider are authorized

AIProviderAuth.description: Authorization of AI provider requests, the credentials of every method are kept
